verses.original: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗א עֲבַד֙ לְחֶ֣ם רַ֔ב לְרַבְרְבָנ֖וֹהִי אֲלַ֑ף וְלָקֳבֵ֥ל אַלְפָּ֖א חַמְרָ֥א שָׁתֵֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar mal·kā ‘ă·ḇaḏ lə·ḥem raḇ lə·raḇ·rə·ḇā·nō·w·hî ’ă·lap̄ wə·lā·qo·ḇêl ’al·pā ḥam·rā šā·ṯêh
verses.literal: Later, King Belshazzar held a great feast for a thousand of his nobles and he drank wine with them
verses.literalPt: O rei Belsazar deu um grande banquete a mil dos seus grandes e bebeu vinho na presença desses mil.

verses.original: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֞ר אֲמַ֣ר׀ בִּטְעֵ֣ם חַמְרָ֗א לְהַיְתָיָה֙ לְמָאנֵי֙ דַּהֲבָ֣א וְכַסְפָּ֔א דִּ֤י הַנְפֵּק֙ נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֣ר אֲב֔וּהִי מִן־ הֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְיִשְׁתּ֣וֹן בְּה֗וֹן מַלְכָּא֙ וְרַבְרְבָנ֔וֹהִי שֵׁגְלָתֵ֖הּ וּלְחֵנָתֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar ’ă·mar biṭ·‘êm ḥam·rā lə·hay·ṯā·yāh lə·mā·nê da·hă·ḇā wə·ḵas·pā dî han·pêq nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar ’ă·ḇū·hî min- hê·ḵə·lā dî ḇî·rū·šə·lem wə·yiš·tō·wn bə·hō·wn mal·kā wə·raḇ·rə·ḇā·nō·w·hî šê·ḡə·lā·ṯêh ū·lə·ḥê·nā·ṯêh
verses.literal: Under the influence of the wine Belshazzar gave orders . . . to bring in the gold and silver vessels that Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken from the temple . . . in Jerusalem so that the king could drink from them along with his nobles his wives and his concubines
verses.literalPt: Belsazar, enquanto tomava o vinho, mandou que fossem trazidos os vasos de ouro e de prata que seu pai, Nabucodonosor, havia tirado do templo que estava em Jerusalém, para que bebessem por eles o rei e seus grandes, suas mulheres e suas concubinas.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֗יִן הַיְתִיו֙ מָאנֵ֣י דַהֲבָ֔א דִּ֣י הַנְפִּ֗קוּ מִן־ הֵֽיכְלָ֛א דִּֽי־ בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירֽוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְאִשְׁתִּ֣יו בְּה֗וֹן מַלְכָּא֙ וְרַבְרְבָנ֔וֹהִי שֵׁגְלָתֵ֖הּ וּלְחֵנָתֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin hay·ṯîw mā·nê ḏa·hă·ḇā dî han·pi·qū min- hê·ḵə·lā dî- ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lā·hā dî ḇî·rū·šə·lem wə·’iš·tîw bə·hō·wn mal·kā wə·raḇ·rə·ḇā·nō·w·hî šê·ḡə·lā·ṯêh ū·lə·ḥê·nā·ṯêh
verses.literal: Thus they brought in the gold vessels that had been taken from the temple . . . the house of God . . . in Jerusalem and the king drank from them along with his nobles his wives and his concubines
verses.literalPt: Então, trouxeram os vasos de ouro que haviam sido tirados do templo da Casa de Deus, que estava em Jerusalém, e por eles beberam o rei e seus grandes, suas mulheres e suas concubinas.

verses.original: אִשְׁתִּ֖יו חַמְרָ֑א וְ֠שַׁבַּחוּ לֵֽאלָהֵ֞י דַּהֲבָ֧א וְכַסְפָּ֛א נְחָשָׁ֥א פַרְזְלָ֖א אָעָ֥א וְאַבְנָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’iš·tîw ḥam·rā wə·šab·ba·ḥū lê·lā·hê da·hă·ḇā wə·ḵas·pā nə·ḥā·šā p̄ar·zə·lā ’ā·‘ā wə·’aḇ·nā
verses.literal: As they drank the wine they praised their gods of gold and silver bronze and iron wood and stone
verses.literalPt: Bebiam vinho e louvavam os deuses de ouro, de prata, de cobre, de ferro, de pau e de pedra.

verses.original: בַּהּ־ שַׁעֲתָ֗ה נְפַקוּ אֶצְבְּעָן֙ דִּ֣י יַד־ אֱנָ֔שׁ וְכָֽתְבָן֙ לָקֳבֵ֣ל נֶבְרַשְׁתָּ֔א עַל־ גִּירָ֕א דִּֽי־ כְתַ֥ל הֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֑א וּמַלְכָּ֣א חָזֵ֔ה פַּ֥ס יְדָ֖ה דִּ֥י כָתְבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bah- ša·‘ă·ṯāh nə·p̄a·qū ’eṣ·bə·‘ān dî yaḏ- ’ĕ·nāš wə·ḵā·ṯə·ḇān lā·qo·ḇêl neḇ·raš·tā ‘al- gî·rā dî- ḵə·ṯal hê·ḵə·lā dî mal·kā ū·mal·kā ḥā·zêh pas yə·ḏāh dî ḵā·ṯə·ḇāh
verses.literal: At that moment the fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the plaster of the wall near the lampstand in the royal palace As the king watched the hand . . . that was writing
verses.literalPt: Na mesma hora, saíram os dedos de mão de homem e escreveram defronte do candeeiro na caiadura da parede do palácio real. O rei via a parte da mão que escrevia.

verses.original: אֱדַ֤יִן מַלְכָּא֙ זִיוֺ֣הִי שְׁנ֔וֹהִי וְרַעיֹנֹ֖הִי יְבַהֲלוּנֵּ֑הּ וְקִטְרֵ֤י חַרְצֵהּ֙ מִשְׁתָּרַ֔יִן וְאַ֨רְכֻבָּתֵ֔הּ דָּ֥א לְדָ֖א נָֽקְשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin mal·kā zi·yō·hî šə·nō·w·hî wə·ra·ʿ·yō·nō·hī yə·ḇa·hă·lūn·nêh wə·qiṭ·rê ḥar·ṣêh miš·tā·ra·yin wə·’ar·ḵub·bā·ṯêh dā lə·ḏā nā·qə·šān
verses.literal: his face grew pale and his thoughts so alarmed him that his hips . . . gave way and his knees knocked together . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, o semblante do rei se mudou, e os seus pensamentos o perturbaram; as juntas dos seus lombos se relaxaram, e os seus joelhos batiam um no outro.

verses.original: קָרֵ֤א מַלְכָּא֙ בְּחַ֔יִל לְהֶֽעָלָה֙ לְאָ֣שְׁפַיָּ֔א כַּשְׂדָּיֵא וְגָזְרַיָּ֑א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֣ר׀ לְחַכִּימֵ֣י בָבֶ֗ל דִּ֣י כָל־ אֱ֠נָשׁ דִּֽי־ יִקְרֵ֞ה כְּתָבָ֣ה דְנָ֗ה וּפִשְׁרֵהּ֙ יְחַוִּנַּ֔נִי אַרְגְּוָנָ֣א יִלְבַּ֗שׁ וְהַמּוֹנְכָא דִֽי־ דַהֲבָא֙ עַֽל־ צַוְּארֵ֔הּ וְתַלְתִּ֥י בְמַלְכוּתָ֖א יִשְׁלַֽט׃ס
verses.transliteration: qā·rê mal·kā bə·ḥa·yil lə·he·‘ā·lāh lə·’ā·šə·p̄ay·yā kaś·då̄·yē wə·ḡā·zə·ray·yā ‘ā·nêh mal·kā wə·’ā·mar lə·ḥak·kî·mê ḇā·ḇel dî ḵāl ’ĕ·nāš dî- yiq·rêh kə·ṯā·ḇāh ḏə·nāh ū·p̄iš·rêh yə·ḥaw·win·na·nî ’ar·gə·wā·nā yil·baš wə·ham·mō·nə·ḵå̄ ḏî- ḏa·hă·ḇā ‘al- ṣaw·wə·rêh wə·ṯal·tî ḇə·mal·ḵū·ṯā yiš·laṭ
verses.literal: The king . . . called out for the enchanters astrologers and diviners to be brought in . . . and he said to these wise men of Babylon Whoever . . . . . . . . . reads this inscription and tells me its interpretation will be clothed in purple and have a gold chain . . . placed around his neck and he will be made the third highest ruler in the kingdom
verses.literalPt: O rei chamou, em alta voz, que se introduzissem os encantadores, os caldeus e os feiticeiros. Falou o rei e disse aos sábios de Babilônia: Qualquer que ler esta escritura e me mostrar a sua interpretação será vestido de púrpura, trará uma cadeia de ouro ao pescoço e terá o terceiro lugar de poder no reino.

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ עָלֲלִין כֹּ֖ל חַכִּימֵ֣י מַלְכָּ֑א וְלָֽא־ כָהֲלִ֤ין כְּתָבָא֙ לְמִקְרֵ֔א וּפִשְׁרָא לְהוֹדָעָ֥ה לְמַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin ʿå̄·lă·līn kōl ḥak·kî·mê mal·kā wə·lā- ḵā·hă·lîn kə·ṯā·ḇā lə·miq·rê ū·p̄iš·rå̄ lə·hō·w·ḏā·‘āh lə·mal·kā
verses.literal: So all the king’s wise men came in but they could not read the inscription or interpret it . . . for him
verses.literalPt: Então, entraram todos os sábios do rei; porém não puderam ler a escritura, nem fazer saber ao rei a interpretação.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן מַלְכָּ֤א בֵלְשַׁאצַּר֙ שַׂגִּ֣יא מִתְבָּהַ֔ל וְזִיוֺ֖הִי שָׁנַ֣יִן עֲל֑וֹהִי וְרַבְרְבָנ֖וֹהִי מִֽשְׁתַּבְּשִֽׁין׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin mal·kā ḇê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar śag·gî miṯ·bā·hal wə·zi·yō·hî šā·na·yin ‘ă·lō·w·hî wə·raḇ·rə·ḇā·nō·w·hî miš·tab·bə·šîn
verses.literal: Then King Belshazzar became even more terrified his face grew even more pale . . . and his nobles were bewildered
verses.literalPt: Nisso, ficou o rei Belsazar muito perturbado, e se lhe mudou o semblante, e os seus grandes estavam perplexos.

verses.original: מַלְכְּתָ֕א לָקֳבֵ֨ל מִלֵּ֤י מַלְכָּא֙ וְרַבְרְבָנ֔וֹהִי לְבֵ֥ית מִשְׁתְּיָ֖א עַלֲלַת עֲנָ֨ת מַלְכְּתָ֜א וַאֲמֶ֗רֶת מַלְכָּא֙ לְעָלְמִ֣ין חֱיִ֔י אַֽל־ יְבַהֲלוּךְ֙ רַעְיוֹנָ֔ךְ וְזִיוָ֖יךְ אַל־ יִשְׁתַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mal·kə·ṯā lā·qo·ḇêl mil·lê mal·kā wə·raḇ·rə·ḇā·nō·w·hî lə·ḇêṯ miš·tə·yā ʿa·lă·laṯ ‘ă·nāṯ mal·kə·ṯā wa·’ă·me·reṯ mal·kā lə·‘ā·lə·mîn ḥĕ·yî ’al- yə·ḇa·hă·lūḵ ra‘·yō·w·nāḵ wə·zî·wāyḵ ’al- yiš·tan·nōw
verses.literal: Hearing the outcry of the king and his nobles the queen entered the banquet hall O king may you live forever she said Do not let your thoughts terrify you or your face . . . grow pale
verses.literalPt: Ora, a rainha, por causa das palavras do rei e dos seus grandes, entrou na casa de banquete; falou a rainha e disse: Ó rei, vive eternamente! Não te perturbem os teus pensamentos, nem se mude o teu semblante.

verses.original: אִיתַ֨י גְּבַ֜ר בְּמַלְכוּתָ֗ךְ דִּ֠י ר֣וּחַ אֱלָהִ֣ין קַדִּישִׁין֮ בֵּהּ֒ וּבְיוֹמֵ֣י אֲב֗וּךְ נַהִיר֧וּ וְשָׂכְלְתָנ֛וּ וְחָכְמָ֥ה כְּחָכְמַת־ אֱלָהִ֖ין הִשְׁתְּכַ֣חַת בֵּ֑הּ וּמַלְכָּ֤א נְבֻֽכַדְנֶצַּר֙ אֲב֔וּךְ רַ֧ב חַרְטֻמִּ֣ין אָֽשְׁפִ֗ין כַּשְׂדָּאִין֙ גָּזְרִ֔ין הֲקִימֵ֖הּ אֲב֥וּךְ מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·ṯay gə·ḇar bə·mal·ḵū·ṯāḵ dî rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lā·hîn qad·dî·šîn bêh ū·ḇə·yō·w·mê ’ă·ḇūḵ na·hî·rū wə·śā·ḵə·lə·ṯā·nū wə·ḥā·ḵə·māh kə·ḥā·ḵə·maṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hîn hiš·tə·ḵa·ḥaṯ bêh ū·mal·kā nə·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar ’ă·ḇūḵ raḇ ḥar·ṭum·mîn ’ā·šə·p̄în kaś·dā·’în gā·zə·rîn hă·qî·mêh ’ă·ḇūḵ mal·kā
verses.literal: There is a man in your kingdom who has the spirit of the holy gods in him In the days of your father he was found to have insight intelligence and wisdom like that of the gods Your father King Nebuchadnezzar appointed him chief of the magicians enchanters astrologers and diviners Your own father the king
verses.literalPt: No teu reino, há um homem que tem em si o espírito dos deuses santos, e, nos dias de teu pai, se acharam nele luz e entendimento, e sabedoria, como a sabedoria dos deuses; o rei Nabucodonosor, teu pai, o rei, digo, teu pai, fê-lo chefe dos mágicos, dos encantadores, dos caldeus e dos feiticeiros;

verses.original: כָּל־ קֳבֵ֡ל דִּ֣י ר֣וּחַ׀ יַתִּירָ֡ה וּמַנְדַּ֡ע וְשָׂכְלְתָנ֡וּ מְפַשַּׁ֣ר חֶלְמִין֩ וַֽאַֽחֲוָיַ֨ת אֲחִידָ֜ן וּמְשָׁרֵ֣א קִטְרִ֗ין הִשְׁתְּכַ֤חַת בֵּהּ֙ בְּדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל דִּֽי־ מַלְכָּ֥א שָׂם־ שְׁמֵ֖הּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר כְּעַ֛ן דָּנִיֵּ֥אל יִתְקְרֵ֖י וּפִשְׁרָ֥ה יְהַֽחֲוֵֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- qo·ḇêl dî rū·aḥ yat·tî·rāh ū·man·da‘ wə·śā·ḵə·lə·ṯā·nū mə·p̄aš·šar ḥel·mîn wa·’a·ḥă·wā·yaṯ ’ă·ḥî·ḏān ū·mə·šā·rê qiṭ·rîn hiš·tə·ḵa·ḥaṯ bêh bə·ḏā·nî·yêl dî- mal·kā śām- šə·mêh bê·lə·ṭə·šaṣ·ṣar kə·‘an dā·nî·yêl yiṯ·qə·rê ū·p̄iš·rāh yə·ha·ḥă·wêh
verses.literal: did this because . . . Daniel the one he named . . . Belteshazzar was found to have an extraordinary spirit as well as knowledge understanding and the ability to interpret dreams explain riddles and solve difficult problems Summon Daniel therefore and he will give you the interpretation
verses.literalPt: porquanto um espírito excelente, e conhecimento, e inteligência, interpretação de sonhos, declaração de enigmas e solução de dúvidas se acharam em Daniel, a quem o rei pôs o nome de Beltessazar. Seja chamado, pois, Daniel, e ele mostrará a interpretação.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל הֻעַ֖ל קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֑א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֣ר לְדָנִיֵּ֗אל אַנְתָּה ה֤וּא דָנִיֵּאל֙ דִּֽי־ מִן־ בְּנֵ֤י גָלוּתָא֙ דִּ֣י יְה֔וּד דִּ֥י הַיְתִ֛י מַלְכָּ֥א אַ֖בִי מִן־ יְהֽוּד׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin dā·nî·yêl hu·‘al qo·ḏām mal·kā ‘ā·nêh mal·kā wə·’ā·mar lə·ḏā·nî·yêl ʾan·tå̄h hū ḏā·nî·yêl dî- min- bə·nê ḡā·lū·ṯā dî yə·hūḏ dî hay·ṯî mal·kā ’a·ḇî min- yə·hūḏ
verses.literal: So Daniel was brought before the king . . . who asked him Are you . . . Daniel one of - the exiles . . . my father the king brought from Judah
verses.literalPt: Então, foi Daniel introduzido à presença do rei. Falou o rei e disse a Daniel: És tu aquele Daniel, um dos filhos do cativeiro de Judá, que o rei, meu pai, trouxe de Judá?

verses.original: וְשִׁמְעֵ֣ת עֲלַיִךְ דִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ אֱלָהִ֖ין בָּ֑ךְ וְנַהִיר֧וּ וְשָׂכְלְתָנ֛וּ וְחָכְמָ֥ה יַתִּירָ֖ה הִשְׁתְּכַ֥חַת בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šim·‘êṯ ʿă·la·yiḵ dî rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lā·hîn bāḵ wə·na·hî·rū wə·śā·ḵə·lə·ṯā·nū wə·ḥā·ḵə·māh yat·tî·rāh hiš·tə·ḵa·ḥaṯ bāḵ
verses.literal: I have heard . . . that the spirit of the gods is in you and that you have insight intelligence and extraordinary wisdom
verses.literalPt: Tenho ouvido a teu respeito que há em ti o espírito dos deuses, e que se acham em ti luz, inteligência e excelente sabedoria.

verses.original: וּכְעַ֞ן הֻעַ֣לּוּ קָֽדָמַ֗י חַכִּֽימַיָּא֙ אָֽשְׁפַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־ כְתָבָ֤ה דְנָה֙ יִקְר֔וֹן וּפִשְׁרֵ֖הּ לְהוֹדָעֻתַ֑נִי וְלָֽא־ כָהֲלִ֥ין פְּשַֽׁר־ מִלְּתָ֖א לְהַחֲוָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·‘an hu·‘al·lū qā·ḏā·may ḥak·kî·may·yā ’ā·šə·p̄ay·yā dî- ḵə·ṯā·ḇāh ḏə·nāh yiq·rō·wn ū·p̄iš·rêh lə·hō·w·ḏā·‘u·ṯa·nî wə·lā- ḵā·hă·lîn pə·šar- mil·lə·ṯā lə·ha·ḥă·wā·yāh
verses.literal: Now the wise men and enchanters . . . were brought before me to read this inscription and interpret it for me but they could not give its interpretation
verses.literalPt: Agora mesmo, foram introduzidos à minha presença os sábios, os encantadores, para que lessem esta escritura e me fizessem saber a interpretação dela; porém não me puderam mostrar a interpretação da coisa.

verses.original: וַאֲנָה֙ שִׁמְעֵ֣ת עֲלַיִךְ דִּֽי־ תוּכַל פִּשְׁרִ֛ין לְמִפְשַׁ֖ר וְקִטְרִ֣ין לְמִשְׁרֵ֑א כְּעַ֡ן הֵן֩ תּוּכַל כְּתָבָ֜א לְמִקְרֵ֗א וּפִשְׁרֵהּ֙ לְהוֹדָ֣עֻתַ֔נִי אַרְגְּוָנָ֣א תִלְבַּ֗שׁ וְהַמּוֹנְכָא דִֽי־ דַהֲבָא֙ עַֽל־ צַוְּארָ֔ךְ וְתַלְתָּ֥א בְמַלְכוּתָ֖א תִּשְׁלַֽט׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nāh šim·‘êṯ ʿă·la·yiḵ dî- ṯū·ḵal piš·rîn lə·mip̄·šar wə·qiṭ·rîn lə·miš·rê kə·‘an hên tū·ḵal kə·ṯā·ḇā lə·miq·rê ū·p̄iš·rêh lə·hō·w·ḏā·‘u·ṯa·nî ’ar·gə·wā·nā ṯil·baš wə·ham·mō·nə·ḵå̄ ḏî- ḏa·hă·ḇā ‘al- ṣaw·wə·rāḵ wə·ṯal·tā ḇə·mal·ḵū·ṯā tiš·laṭ
verses.literal: But I have heard about you that you are able to give interpretations . . . and solve difficult problems Therefore if you can read this inscription and give me its interpretation you will be clothed in purple and have a gold chain placed around your neck and you will be made the third highest ruler in the kingdom
verses.literalPt: Mas tenho ouvido a teu respeito que tu podes dar interpretações e solver dúvidas. Se, pois, puderes ler a escritura e me fazer saber a interpretação dela, serás vestido de púrpura, trarás uma cadeia de ouro ao pescoço e terás o terceiro lugar de poder no reino.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן עָנֵ֣ה דָנִיֵּ֗אל וְאָמַר֙ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּ֔א מַתְּנָתָךְ֙ לָ֣ךְ לֶֽהֶוְיָ֔ן וּנְבָ֥זְבְּיָתָ֖ךְ לְאָחֳרָ֣ן הַ֑ב בְּרַ֗ם כְּתָבָא֙ אֶקְרֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֔א וּפִשְׁרָ֖א אֲהוֹדְעִנֵּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin ‘ā·nêh ḏā·nî·yêl wə·’ā·mar qo·ḏām mal·kā mat·tə·nā·ṯāḵ lāḵ le·hew·yān ū·nə·ḇā·zə·bə·yā·ṯāḵ lə·’ā·ḥo·rān haḇ bə·ram kə·ṯā·ḇā ’eq·rê lə·mal·kā ū·p̄iš·rā ’ă·hō·wḏ·‘in·nêh
verses.literal: In response Daniel said . . . . . . to the king You may keep your gifts for yourself and give your rewards to someone else Nevertheless I will read the inscription for the king and interpret it for him
verses.literalPt: Então, respondeu Daniel e disse na presença do rei: Sejam para ti as tuas dádivas, e dá a outrem os teus prêmios; contudo, eu lerei ao rei a escritura e lhe farei saber a interpretação.

verses.original: אַנְתָּה מַלְכָּ֑א אֱלָהָא֙ עִלָּיָא מַלְכוּתָ֤א וּרְבוּתָא֙ וִיקָרָ֣א וְהַדְרָ֔ה יְהַ֖ב לִנְבֻכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר אֲבֽוּךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ʾan·tå̄h mal·kā ’ĕ·lā·hā ʿil·lå̄·yå̄ mal·ḵū·ṯā ū·rə·ḇū·ṯā wî·qā·rā wə·haḏ·rāh yə·haḇ lin·ḇu·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar ’ă·ḇūḵ
verses.literal: As for you O king the Most High God gave your father Nebuchadnezzar sovereignty and greatness glory and honor
verses.literalPt: O Altíssimo Deus, ó rei, deu a teu pai, Nabucodonosor, o reino, e grandeza, e glória, e majestade;

verses.original: וּמִן־ רְבוּתָא֙ דִּ֣י יְהַב־ לֵ֔הּ כֹּ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗א אֻמַיָּא֙ וְלִשָּׁ֣נַיָּ֔א הֲו֛וֹ זָאֲעִין וְדָחֲלִ֖ין מִן־ קֳדָמ֑וֹהִי דִּֽי־ הֲוָ֨ה צָבֵ֜א הֲוָ֣א קָטֵ֗ל וְדִֽי־ הֲוָ֤ה צָבֵא֙ הֲוָ֣ה מַחֵ֔א וְדִֽי־ הֲוָ֤ה צָבֵא֙ הֲוָ֣ה מָרִ֔ים וְדִֽי־ הֲוָ֥ה צָבֵ֖א הֲוָ֥ה מַשְׁפִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- rə·ḇū·ṯā dî yə·haḇ- lêh kōl ‘am·may·yā ’u·may·yā wə·liš·šā·nay·yā hă·wōw zå̄·ʾă·ʿīn wə·ḏā·ḥă·lîn min- qo·ḏā·mō·w·hî dî- hă·wāh ṣā·ḇê hă·wā qā·ṭêl wə·ḏî- hă·wāh ṣā·ḇê hă·wāh ma·ḥê wə·ḏî- hă·wāh ṣā·ḇê hă·wāh mā·rîm wə·ḏî- hă·wāh ṣā·ḇê hă·wāh maš·pîl
verses.literal: Because of the greatness that He bestowed on him the people of every nation and language trembled in fear before him He killed whom he wished and kept alive whom he wished . . . he exalted whom he wished . . . and humbled whom he wished . . .
verses.literalPt: e, por causa da grandeza que lhe deu, todos os povos, nações e línguas tremiam e temiam diante dele; a quem queria matava; e a quem ele queria conservava em vida; a quem queria exaltava; e a quem queria abatia.

verses.original: וּכְדִי֙ רִ֣ם לִבְבֵ֔הּ וְרוּחֵ֖הּ תִּֽקְפַ֣ת לַהֲזָדָ֑ה הָנְחַת֙ מִן־ כָּרְסֵ֣א מַלְכוּתֵ֔הּ וִֽיקָרָ֖ה הֶעְדִּ֥יוּ מִנֵּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḏî rim liḇ·ḇêh wə·rū·ḥêh tiq·p̄aṯ la·hă·zā·ḏāh hā·nə·ḥaṯ min- kā·rə·sê mal·ḵū·ṯêh wî·qā·rāh he‘·di·yū min·nêh
verses.literal: But when his heart became arrogant and his spirit was hardened with pride he was deposed from his royal throne and his glory was taken from him
verses.literalPt: Quando, porém, o seu coração se elevou, e o seu espírito se endureceu, de sorte que se houve arrogantemente, foi ele deposto do seu trono real, e tiraram-lhe a sua glória;

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵי֩ אֲנָשָׁ֨א טְרִ֜יד וְלִבְבֵ֣הּ׀ עִם־ חֵיוְתָ֣א שְׁוִי וְעִם־ עֲרָֽדַיָּא֙ מְדוֹרֵ֔הּ עִשְׂבָּ֤א כְתוֹרִין֙ יְטַ֣עֲמוּנֵּ֔הּ וּמִטַּ֥ל שְׁמַיָּ֖א גִּשְׁמֵ֣הּ יִצְטַבַּ֑ע עַ֣ד דִּֽי־ יְדַ֗ע דִּֽי־ שַׁלִּ֞יט אֱלָהָ֤א עִלָּיָא בְּמַלְכ֣וּת אֲנָשָׁ֔א וּלְמַן־ דִּ֥י יִצְבֵּ֖ה יְהָקֵ֥ים עֲלַיֵהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê ’ă·nā·šā ṭə·rîḏ wə·liḇ·ḇêh ‘im- ḥê·wə·ṯā šə·wī wə·‘im- ‘ă·rā·ḏay·yā mə·ḏō·w·rêh ‘iś·bā ḵə·ṯō·w·rîn yə·ṭa·‘ă·mūn·nêh ū·miṭ·ṭal šə·may·yā giš·mêh yiṣ·ṭab·ba‘ ‘aḏ dî- yə·ḏa‘ dî- šal·lîṭ ’ĕ·lā·hā ʿil·lå̄·yå̄ bə·mal·ḵūṯ ’ă·nā·šā ū·lə·man- dî yiṣ·bêh yə·hā·qêm ʿă·la·yēh
verses.literal: He was driven away from mankind . . . and his mind was like that of a beast . . . He lived with the wild donkeys and ate grass like an ox and his body was drenched with the dew of heaven until . . . he acknowledged that the Most High God rules over the kingdom of mankind setting over it whom . . . He wishes
verses.literalPt: e foi expulso dentre os filhos dos homens, o seu coração foi feito como o dos animais, e a sua morada era com os jumentos monteses; foi sustentado de feno, como boi, e o seu corpo foi molhado do orvalho do céu, até que conheceu que o Altíssimo Deus domina no reino dos homens e a quem quiser constitui sobre ele.

verses.original: וְאַנְתָּה בְּרֵהּ֙ בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֔ר לָ֥א הַשְׁפֵּ֖לְתְּ לִבְבָ֑ךְ כָּל־ קֳבֵ֕ל דִּ֥י כָל־ דְּנָ֖ה יְדַֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ʾan·tå̄h bə·rêh bê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar lā haš·pê·lət liḇ·ḇāḵ kāl- qo·ḇêl dî ḵāl də·nāh yə·ḏa‘·tā
verses.literal: But you his son O Belshazzar have not humbled your heart even though . . . . . . you knew all this
verses.literalPt: Tu, Belsazar, que és seu filho, não humilhaste o coração, embora soubesses tudo isso;

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל מָרֵֽא־ שְׁמַיָּ֣א׀ הִתְרוֹמַ֡מְתָּ וּלְמָֽאנַיָּ֨א דִֽי־ בַיְתֵ֜הּ הַיְתִ֣יו קָדָמַיִךְ וְאַנְתָּה וְרַבְרְבָנַיִךְ שֵֽׁגְלָתָ֣ךְ וּלְחֵנָתָךְ֮ חַמְרָא֮ שָׁתַ֣יִן בְּהוֹן֒ וְלֵֽאלָהֵ֣י כַסְפָּֽא־ וְ֠דַהֲבָא נְחָשָׁ֨א פַרְזְלָ֜א אָעָ֣א וְאַבְנָ֗א דִּ֠י לָֽא־ חָזַ֧יִן וְלָא־ שָׁמְעִ֛ין וְלָ֥א יָדְעִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֑חְתָּ וְלֵֽאלָהָ֞א דִּֽי־ נִשְׁמְתָ֥ךְ בִּידֵ֛הּ וְכָל־ אֹרְחָתָ֥ךְ לֵ֖הּ לָ֥א הַדַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al mā·rê- šə·may·yā hiṯ·rō·w·mam·tā ū·lə·mā·nay·yā ḏî- ḇay·ṯêh hay·ṯîw qå̄·ḏå̄·ma·yiḵ wə·ʾan·tå̄h wə·raḇ·rə·ḇå̄·na·yiḵ šê·ḡə·lā·ṯāḵ ū·lə·ḥê·nā·ṯāḵ ḥam·rā šā·ṯa·yin bə·hō·wn wə·lê·lā·hê ḵas·pā- wə·ḏa·hă·ḇā nə·ḥā·šā p̄ar·zə·lā ’ā·‘ā wə·’aḇ·nā dî lā- ḥā·za·yin wə·lā- šā·mə·‘în wə·lā yā·ḏə·‘în šab·baḥ·tā wə·lê·lā·hā dî- niš·mə·ṯāḵ bî·ḏêh wə·ḵāl ’ō·rə·ḥā·ṯāḵ lêh lā had·dar·tā
verses.literal: Instead, you have exalted yourself against the Lord of heaven The vessels from His house were brought to you and as you drank wine from them with your nobles wives and concubines you praised your gods of silver and gold bronze and iron wood and stone which cannot see or hear or understand But you have failed to glorify the God who holds in His hand your very breath and all your ways
verses.literalPt: porém te elevaste contra o Senhor do céu. Trouxeram perante ti os vasos da casa dele, e por eles bebestes vinho, tu e teus grandes, tuas mulheres e tuas concubinas; e louvaste os deuses de prata, de ouro, de cobre, de ferro, de pau e de pedra, que não veem, nem ouvem, nem sabem; e ao Deus, em cuja mão está o teu fôlego e de quem são todos os teus caminhos, a ele não glorificaste.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ מִן־ קֳדָמ֔וֹהִי שְׁלִ֖יַחַ פַּסָּ֣א דִֽי־ יְדָ֑א וּכְתָבָ֥א דְנָ֖ה רְשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin min- qo·ḏā·mō·w·hî šə·li·ya·aḥ pas·sā ḏî- yə·ḏā ū·ḵə·ṯā·ḇā ḏə·nāh rə·šîm
verses.literal: Therefore . . . . . . He sent . . . . . . the hand that wrote the inscription
verses.literalPt: Então, foi a parte da mão enviada de diante dele, e foi inscrita esta escritura.

verses.original: וּדְנָ֥ה כְתָבָ֖א דִּ֣י רְשִׁ֑ים מְנֵ֥א מְנֵ֖א תְּקֵ֥ל וּפַרְסִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·nāh ḵə·ṯā·ḇā dî rə·šîm mə·nê mə·nê tə·qêl ū·p̄ar·sîn
verses.literal: Now this is the inscription that was written MENE MENE TEKEL PARSIN
verses.literalPt: Esta é a escritura que foi inscrita: MENE, MENE, TEQUEL, PARSIM.

verses.original: דְּנָ֖ה פְּשַֽׁר־ מִלְּתָ֑א מְנֵ֕א מְנָֽה־ אֱלָהָ֥א מַלְכוּתָ֖ךְ וְהַשְׁלְמַֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: də·nāh pə·šar- mil·lə·ṯā mə·nê mə·nāh- ’ĕ·lā·hā mal·ḵū·ṯāḵ wə·haš·lə·mah
verses.literal: And this is the interpretation of the message MENE means that God has numbered the days of your reign and brought it to an end
verses.literalPt: Esta é a sua interpretação. MENE: Deus contou o teu reino e o acabou.

verses.original: תְּקֵ֑ל תְּקִ֥ילְתָּה בְמֹֽאזַנְיָ֖א וְהִשְׁתְּכַ֥חַתְּ חַסִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: tə·qêl tə·qî·lə·tāh ḇə·mō·zan·yā wə·hiš·tə·ḵa·ḥat ḥas·sîr
verses.literal: TEKEL means that you have been weighed on the scales and found deficient
verses.literalPt: TEQUEL: Pesado na balança e achado em falta.

verses.original: פְּרֵ֑ס פְּרִיסַת֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ךְ וִיהִיבַ֖ת לְמָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: pə·rês pə·rî·saṯ mal·ḵū·ṯāḵ wî·hî·ḇaṯ lə·mā·ḏay ū·p̄ā·rās
verses.literal: PERES means that your kingdom has been divided and given over to the Medes and Persians
verses.literalPt: PERES: Está dividido o teu reino e entregue aos medos e aos persas.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן׀ אֲמַ֣ר בֵּלְשַׁאצַּ֗ר וְהַלְבִּ֤ישׁוּ לְדָֽנִיֵּאל֙ אַרְגְּוָנָ֔א וְהַמּוֹנְכָא דִֽי־ דַהֲבָ֖א עַֽל־ צַוְּארֵ֑הּ וְהַכְרִ֣זֽוּ עֲל֔וֹהִי דִּֽי־ לֶהֱוֵ֥א שַׁלִּ֛יט תַּלְתָּ֖א בְּמַלְכוּתָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin ’ă·mar bê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar wə·hal·bî·šū lə·ḏā·nî·yêl ’ar·gə·wā·nā wə·ham·mō·nə·ḵå̄ ḏî- ḏa·hă·ḇā ‘al- ṣaw·wə·rêh wə·haḵ·ri·zū ‘ă·lō·w·hî dî- le·hĕ·wê šal·lîṭ tal·tā bə·mal·ḵū·ṯā
verses.literal: Then Belshazzar gave the command and they clothed Daniel in purple placed a gold chain around his neck and proclaimed him . . . the third highest ruler in the kingdom
verses.literalPt: Então, Belsazar deu as suas ordens; vestiram de púrpura a Daniel e puseram-lhe ao pescoço uma cadeia de ouro, e fez-se uma proclamação a respeito dele, que tivesse o terceiro lugar de poder no reino.

verses.original: בֵּ֚הּ בְּלֵ֣ילְיָ֔א קְטִ֕יל בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֖ר מַלְכָּ֥א כַשְׂדָּיָא׃פ
verses.transliteration: bêh bə·lê·lə·yā qə·ṭîl bê·lə·šaṣ·ṣar mal·kā ḵaś·då̄·yå̄
verses.literal: That very night Belshazzar king of the Chaldeans was slain
verses.literalPt: Naquela noite, foi morto Belsazar, rei caldeu.

verses.original: וְדָרְיָ֙וֶשׁ֙ מָֽדָיאָ֔ קַבֵּ֖ל מַלְכוּתָ֑א כְּבַ֥ר שְׁנִ֖ין שִׁתִּ֥ין וְתַרְתֵּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš må̄·ḏå̄y·ʾå̄ qab·bêl mal·ḵū·ṯā kə·ḇar šə·nîn šit·tîn wə·ṯar·tên
verses.literal: and Darius the Mede received the kingdom at the age . . . of sixty-two . . .
verses.literalPt: Dario, o medo, recebeu o reino, tendo mais ou menos sessenta e dois anos de idade.
